nonliteral_occurrences_left_plain.English: Pressure reduction and thermal vaporization can each create a moving cavity. nonliteral_occurrences_left_plain.English: Model one spherical cavity in an infinite incompressible Newtonian carrier. Fix its center. Radius increases outward into the liquid. Positive wall velocity means expansion. Density, viscosity and effective surface tension remain constant. Omit gravity, bulk vorticity, phase-transfer velocity slip and gas viscous stress. Internal pressure is spatially uniform and may vary with time. The model describes one transient without periodic acoustic forcing.
